mapper.insert: insert into tbl_together_member(together_id, member_id, together_role) values (#{togetherId}, #{memberId}, #{togetherRole}::together_role)
mapper.select: select id, together_id, member_id, together_role, together_guest_member, created_datetime from tbl_together_member where id = #{id}

select tm.id, tm.together_id, tm.member_id, tm.together_role, tm.together_guest_member, tm.created_datetime, coalesce(m.member_alias, '여행자') as member_alias from tbl_together_member tm join tbl_member m on m.id = tm.member_id where tm.together_id = #{togetherId} order by tm.id
